method.name: default
method.description: Empty Constructor

method.name: from_2
method.description: Initislises by shape.

method.name: Init
method.description: Initislises by shape.

method.name: Perform
method.description: Iterates on sub- shape and performs fixes

method.name: Shape
method.description: Returns resulting shape

method.name: FixSolidTool
method.description: Returns tool for fixing solids.

method.name: FixShellTool
method.description: Returns tool for fixing shells.

method.name: FixFaceTool
method.description: Returns tool for fixing faces.

method.name: FixWireTool
method.description: Returns tool for fixing wires.

method.name: FixEdgeTool
method.description: Returns tool for fixing edges.

method.name: Status
method.description: Returns the status of the last Fix. This can be a combination of the following flags: ShapeExtend_DONE1: some free edges were fixed ShapeExtend_DONE2: some free wires were fixed ShapeExtend_DONE3: some free faces were fixed ShapeExtend_DONE4: some free shells were fixed ShapeExtend_DONE5: some free solids were fixed ShapeExtend_DONE6: shapes in compound(s) were fixed

method.name: SetMsgRegistrator
method.description: Sets message registrator

method.name: SetPrecision
method.description: Sets basic precision value (also to FixSolidTool)

method.name: SetMinTolerance
method.description: Sets minimal allowed tolerance (also to FixSolidTool)

method.name: SetMaxTolerance
method.description: Sets maximal allowed tolerance (also to FixSolidTool)

method.name: FixSolidMode
method.description: Returns (modifiable) the mode for applying fixes of ShapeFix_Solid, by default True.

method.name: FixFreeShellMode
method.description: Returns (modifiable) the mode for applying fixes of ShapeFix_Shell, by default True.

method.name: FixFreeFaceMode
method.description: Returns (modifiable) the mode for applying fixes of ShapeFix_Face, by default True.

method.name: FixFreeWireMode
method.description: Returns (modifiable) the mode for applying fixes of ShapeFix_Wire, by default True.

method.name: FixSameParameterMode
method.description: Returns (modifiable) the mode for applying ShapeFix::SameParameter after all fixes, by default True.

method.name: FixVertexPositionMode
method.description: Returns (modifiable) the mode for applying ShapeFix::FixVertexPosition before all fixes, by default False.

method.name: FixVertexTolMode
method.description: Returns (modifiable) the mode for fixing tolerances of vertices on whole shape after performing all fixes
